question: What exact registration evidence exists for each committee ID referenced by the receiver-reported flow graph but absent from its selected cycle committee master?

inputs.role: The exact flow calculation, referenced endpoint population, and selected current-cycle committee master.
inputs.version_policy: Pin the immutable v1 readiness bundle, calculation manifest, result artifact, and selected committee-master fact set.

inputs.role: Exact-ID registration assertions from explicit alternate-release, normalized historical, and official historical bulk inputs.
inputs.version_policy: Pin every normalized fact-set digest and every raw archive storage key, archive digest, member, row digest, and parse issue.

identity.result_key: reported committee ID + graph cycle + exact flow-bundle identity + exact registration-evidence identities + method version
identity.input_manifest: The exact v1 flow bundle, flow calculation, selected master, comparison masters, normalized histories, and raw historical archives.
identity.result_digest: SHA-256 over the versioned calculation identity; each decision ID additionally binds the committee ID and explicit state.

ordered_steps: Verify the complete v1 flow bundle and reconstruct every exact reported committee endpoint absent from its selected committee master.
Join registration assertions only by the exact reported FEC committee ID. Never use a name to repair or replace an ID.
Publish historical_registration when exact official historical evidence exists, preserving all historical and alternate-release assertions.
Publish alternate_release_registration when exact evidence exists only in a different same-cycle release.
Publish unresolved_reported_id when no audited committee master contains the exact reported ID.
Mark every gap decision terminal-identity-ineligible; current-cycle committee masters are the only eligible identity state at this boundary.

decision_states.meaning: The exact reported ID occurs in at least one official historical committee master; assertions remain historical evidence rather than current canonical fields.
The exact reported ID occurs only in a different same-cycle release and remains outside the selected master.
The exact reported ID is absent from every explicitly audited committee-master source.

invariants: Every graph endpoint has exactly one coverage state: selected current-cycle master or one published gap decision.
Historical names and attributes are assertions, not canonical replacements for the selected cycle.
Name similarity, contributor name, linkage, and candidate summary data cannot manufacture committee identity.
Historical, alternate-release, and unresolved states cannot stop terminal-source traversal.
Every raw historical assertion retains exact archive and row evidence, including parse issues.

output.grain: One immutable decision per exact reported committee ID absent from the selected current-cycle committee master.

publication_states.meaning: Every selected-master gap has one exact-ID evidence state and terminal eligibility is conserved.
Input lineage, registration evidence, decision membership, or state conservation failed verification.

revisions.input_change_policy: A changed flow bundle or registration-evidence identity creates a new immutable calculation for that cycle.
revisions.method_change_policy: Any change to exact-ID matching, state precedence, evidence retention, or terminal eligibility requires a new calculation version.
revisions.history_policy: Retain every immutable calculation, decision artifact, source manifest, and raw official historical archive indefinitely.

checks.rule: Every selected and comparison source passes immutable-manifest and complete backing verification.
Current-cycle masters plus gap decisions equal all referenced graph committees.
Every gap has exactly one state and one decision record.
Only selected current-cycle master identities are terminal-identity-eligible.
No name or contextual field can repair a reported committee ID.
Official registration assertions retain exact cycle, source, row, field, and issue evidence.

propagation.no_change_policy: Identical evidence identities and method version reuse the immutable calculation; candidate linkage and summary changes do not invalidate identity decisions.

use.retention: Retain explicit uncertainty in the graph and expose registration assertions to investigative consumers without collapsing them into current canonical identity.
use.disclaimer: Registration evidence establishes only that an exact FEC committee ID appeared in an official committee master. It does not establish corporate control, ideology, candidate control, illegality, corruption, or beneficial ownership.
